Famous claims, counted

"Claimed" numbers are as commonly cited online. This page only counts; it doesn't rule on them. Each result depends on the stated counting method. Flip the method on any card to see how much the count moves. Root-based claims (e.g. shaytan / malak = 88, reward / forgiveness = 117 / 234) need a root lexicon and can't be tested from the text alone.

Base text: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani Minimal, Version 1.1), Hafs numbering, embedded unmodified. Copyright © Tanzil Project, licensed CC BY 3.0. Please check updates at tanzil.net/updates.
English: Saheeh International (Tanzil, last update April 24, 2011). Bengali: Muhiuddin Khan (Tanzil, last update April 30, 2011). Translations embedded unmodified.
Word meanings: word-by-word glosses from the npm package @kmaslesa/holy-quran-word-by-word-full-data 1.0.6 (ISC). The package doesn't state who wrote the glosses. Verses 2:181, 8:6, 13:37 and 37:130 have no word-level meanings because their word segmentation differs from the Tanzil text.
Tanzil's file prepends the Bismillah to ayah 1 of 112 surahs. This page strips it, so word counts reflect the verses themselves.
Every number on this page is computed in your browser from that text. Word counts depend on the matching method shown under each result.
